payload.summary: Reconfirmed on current main: PhysicsLabStudioHarness.get() returns the raw owned RealizedLab, including its destroy() capability, so external callers can dispose the physical/runtime lab without clearing the harness current owner.
payload.impact: An out-of-band destroy leaves Harness.get() pointing at a destroyed handle while Harness.start() still refuses replacement because current is non-nil. This can poison the permanent Studio validation harness and violates centralized exactly-one-lab lifecycle ownership.
sourceProof: main@ae83c0ef470eb2e73d99be41fd3561ede30c40e1 src/server/PhysicsLab/PhysicsLabStudioHarness.luau assigns the raw PhysicsLabRealizer.realize() result to private current and returns current directly from get()
stop() is the only harness-owned path that destroys active and then clears current; get() exposes destroy without that atomic owner release
authority stack PR #394 explicitly states the raw PhysicsLabStudioHarness.get()/RealizedLab.destroy capability finding remains out of scope
the previously recommended HG-AUTHORITY-HARNESS-LIFECYCLE-CAPABILITY lane is still absent from live swarm-control
payload.nonDuplicate: PR #394 adds teardown/source-order regression coverage only and no production harness delta. Repository PR search found no open implementation closing raw destroy exposure or stale current after external destroy.
recommendedClosure: materialize the bounded HG-AUTHORITY-HARNESS-LIFECYCLE-CAPABILITY one-shot lane
centralize destroy/release under the harness or return a narrow read-only/operational facade without raw destroy authority
regression-lock that callers cannot leave current bound to a destroyed lab and that deterministic replacement remains possible
preserve existing stop idempotency, restart destroy-before-reacquire ordering, and Studio/server guards
keep this source-only; do not convert it into HG151-TWOCLIENT or Studio evidence PASS
payload.supersedesFinding: evt-20260811-123820-j4m8q2v7-authority-harness-destroy-capability only by freshness; technical finding is unchanged
